extraction_notes: Only catalyst-performance records for the four catalyst names supplied for this paper were extracted. SI Table S2 is an activation-energy comparison table and was not extracted; rows marked with literature references are out of scope. SI Figures S7 and S8 show activation/time-on-stream traces, but many temperature/time points are not tabulated and exact values are not reliably readable from the supplied image. SI Figure S15 reports TOF plots, but the plotted/inset values are not sufficiently readable to extract exact point values without a high-resolution source; therefore TOFs were left null rather than estimated.
